q: Researchers found that sleeping glassfrogs become more transparent by packing much of their red blood supply into which organ?
d: The cells leave general circulation while the frogs rest and return when they become active. Hiding the red cells makes the body less visible through its translucent tissues.
s: American Museum of Natural History · Glassfrog Camouflage
